SCAM_PREDICTION.label: Message classified as a possible scam

OTP_REQUEST.label: Asks for an OTP, PIN or password

BANK_DETAILS_REQUEST.label: Asks for bank or card details

PAYMENT_REQUEST.label: Asks for a payment, transfer or gift card

CREDENTIAL_LINK_REQUEST.label: Asks you to log in through a link

IMPERSONATION.label: Claims to be from a bank, government body or known company

ACCOUNT_THREAT.label: Threatens account closure, a fine or legal action

URGENCY_PRESSURE.label: Uses urgency or a short deadline

PRIZE_BAIT.label: Promises a prize, refund or reward

SENSITIVE_INFO_REQUEST.label: Asks for identity or personal information

MALICIOUS_URL.label: Link flagged as malicious or a phishing page

LOOKALIKE_DOMAIN.label: Link imitates the address of a known website

IP_ADDRESS_URL.label: Link uses a raw IP address instead of a domain name

SHORTENED_URL.label: Link is shortened, so the destination is hidden

NO_HTTPS.label: Link does not use a secure connection

OTP_REQUEST_WITH_LINK.label: OTP is requested together with an external link

MESSAGE_ANALYSIS_UNAVAILABLE.label: Message content could not be checked for scam patterns

URL_ANALYSIS_UNAVAILABLE.label: Link safety could not be checked

overrides.reason: The scam model is highly confident that this message is fraudulent.
The URL analysis module flagged the link as malicious.
An OTP is requested while the message also pushes an external link.

actions.NEVER_SHARE_OTP: Never share an OTP, PIN or password. No bank, police officer or company will ever ask for it.
actions.NEVER_SHARE_BANK_DETAILS: Do not give out your bank account, card or identity numbers.
actions.DO_NOT_TRANSFER_MONEY: Do not transfer money to anyone you have not confirmed in person or by a number you looked up yourself.
actions.DO_NOT_CLICK_LINK: Do not click the link. Open the organisation's own app or type its address yourself.
actions.DO_NOT_RESPOND: Do not reply to this message and do not call any number it gives you.
actions.VERIFY_OFFICIAL_CHANNEL: Check with the organisation using the phone number printed on your card, bill or passbook.
actions.VERIFY_SENDER: Confirm who really sent this before you respond or share anything.
actions.TAKE_TIME: Take your time. Genuine organisations do not rush you or threaten you.
actions.REPORT_MESSAGE: Report the message and block the sender, then delete it.
actions.KEEP_CAUTIOUS: Stay cautious with messages you were not expecting, even ones that look harmless.

warnings.LOW: No major suspicious activity was detected. Stay cautious.
warnings.MEDIUM: This message contains some suspicious elements. Verify the sender before responding.
warnings.HIGH: Warning! This message may be fraudulent. Do not share OTPs, passwords or banking details.

degraded_warnings.LOW: No major suspicious activity was detected, but we could not finish every check. Stay cautious.
degraded_warnings.MEDIUM: We could not finish checking everything, and some suspicious elements were found. Verify the sender before responding.
degraded_warnings.HIGH: Warning! This message may be fraudulent, and we could not finish every check. Do not share OTPs, passwords or banking details.
